paragraphs: Ahavah, father of Rav Adda. See Midrash Hanne'elam on “Let the earth bring forth a living soul”: Rabbi Yose ben Azzi told of his birth and wisdom when seven years old. Rabbi Alexandri was his teacher; he saw his son Rav Adda (see Nishmat Chayyim, discourse 2, chapter 2).
